reportKind: Synthetic fresh-process import workflow; completed-import conditional statistics
scope: Fresh-process create-case/import-filesystem/persist workflow with warm OS file caches. No GUI and no ingest modules.

method.primary: Popen start through application process exit, including bootstrap and persistence; owned Solr cleanup is afterwards
method.native: Release application core, selected-file SHA-256 + before/after source checks + logical SHA-256 + helper enumeration + JSON cache
method.autopsy: Full NetBeans CLI, fresh user/cache/case and private Solr, image import into SQLite, adapted macOS ARM64 runtime
method.sampling: 5 ms libproc exact owned process group, observes Native CLI/helper or Autopsy JVM/Solr. RSS sampled and CPU lower bound; unavailable per-process readings are retained as coverage gaps, not zero consumption.
method.validation: Exact paths, sizes, allocation, stream identity where declared, image timezone UTC and byte-exact known exports outside timing. Raw timestamp differences are reported separately; no complete metadata parity claim.
method.cache: Hashes before each run warm OS caches; Autopsy NetBeans user/module cache is fresh each run; no disk cache flush
method.baselineLimitation: Upstream three-module Mac-compatible reference failed Solr readiness despite healthy private service; installed-adapted timings are not pristine vendor-stock timings.

postMeasurementValidation.samplerReceiptLabelClarification: After measurement, resourceCoverageComplete was renamed noSamplerErrors and coverage declared unproven. Counters and timers were unchanged; recorded recipe hashes identify the measured code.

resourceLimitations: 5 ms requested libproc polling; actual intervals are reported for each run.
Sampler uses libproc PROC_PGRP_ONLY/rusage_info_v2 and exact new-session group/PID creation identities; PID identities are redacted.
RSS is a sequential sampled aggregate of observed owned processes; peaks and short-lived children can be missed.
CPU and disk counters sum last-live samples and are lower bounds; they are not wait4 complete process totals.
Native helper was not necessarily observed in every short run. No recorded errors does not prove full child coverage.
Autopsy bootstrap utility EPERM sampling failures are retained by executable basename/errno/count.
Java process roles are unresolved in these receipts. JVM totals include observed Autopsy, bootstrap and Solr processes.
RSS/CPU exclude the Python coordinator and desktop GUI. Owned Solr cleanup happens after the app wall timer.

originalMacCompatibleReference.failure: Application did not pass Solr readiness; no completed-import time or speed ratio.

sanitization.preserved: Every warmup, measured successful attempt, retained failure, actual order, wall sample, native core stage, sampled resource receipt, fixture identity and raw metadata difference.
